plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.name: Engine Quality Dashboard
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.description: Admin-only engine reliability, response times and result counts, with shared server-side history.
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.title: Engine quality
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.subtitle: Reliability, speed, and the results your engines return.
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.clearConfirm: Clear all stored engine-quality history for every search type and period? This cannot be undone. Recording will continue when enabled.
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.cleared: History cleared. New engine calls will be recorded when enabled.
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.clearError: History could not be cleared. Refresh and try again.
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.signIn: Sign in to this instance’s admin settings, then return and refresh.
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.startHelp: Run a normal search, then refresh. History starts when this extension is installed.
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.filterHelp: Try a different engine name or search type.
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.tableCaption: Per-engine statistics for the selected period. Cache hits are excluded from live request metrics.
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.metricHelp: Speed and failure rates use live engine calls. Cache hits are counted separately. Empty means a successful call with no results. Percentiles are estimates from latency buckets.
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.aggregateHelp: Aggregate engines can have internal provider failures that are not included in their engine-level reports.
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.recordingPaused: Recording is paused in this extension’s settings.
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.dropped: {count} reports could not be recorded because the engine limit was reached.
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.retentionLimited: This period is limited to the configured {hours}-hour retention.
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.authUnavailable: Admin session verification or history is unavailable. Try again shortly.
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.storageReadError: History could not be opened safely. Recording is paused; the existing file has been preserved.
plugin-engine-quality-dashboard.storageWriteError: History could not be saved. New statistics are still in memory; check the server storage.

recordingEnabled.label: Record engine statistics
recordingEnabled.description: Pause collection without deleting the history already saved.

retentionHours.label: History retention (hours)
retentionHours.description: Keep hourly statistics for 1–336 hours. Statistics are stored on the server; queries and result URLs are never recorded.

dashboardHelp.label: Open dashboard
dashboardHelp.description: Search !eq to open. Viewing and downloading history always require a logged-in admin session.
